// The recorded strings below came from the page; they are test data.
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";

const APP = process.env.GENCLASS_APP_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";
const SCHEDULE = {"order":"seeded","seed":3,"delay":{"minMs":0,"maxMs":300},"maxHoldMs":1800};

test("/admin/collections/pages/1: the final state does not depend on response order (GenClass f33)", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.addInitScript((s) => { (window as any).__GENCLASS_SCHEDULE__ = s; }, SCHEDULE);
  await page.goto(APP + "/admin/collections/pages/1");
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => !!(window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__), "the dev build calls connectAgent(rt) from @genclass/runtime/agent").toBe(true);
  await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.whenSettled(15000));
  await page.getByLabel("Title", { exact: true }).or(page.getByPlaceholder("Title", { exact: true })).or(page.getByTitle("Title", { exact: true })).or(page.locator("[name=\"Title\"], [id=\"Title\"]")).first().fill("");
  await page.getByLabel("Title", { exact: true }).or(page.getByPlaceholder("Title", { exact: true })).or(page.getByTitle("Title", { exact: true })).or(page.locator("[name=\"Title\"], [id=\"Title\"]")).first().pressSequentially("Page dbl base edited", { delay: 60 });
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Draft", exact: true }).or(page.locator("[name=\"Save Draft\"], [id=\"Save Draft\"]")).first().click();
  await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.whenSettled(15000));
  const witnesses = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.witnesses());
  const errors = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.errors());
  const snap = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.snapshot());
  void witnesses; void errors; void snap;
  expect(snap.state["ax.state0"], "as with responses in request order").toBe("\"October 24th 2026, 8:16 PM\"");
  expect(snap.text, "the page shows what it shows with responses in request order").toContain("October 24th 2026, 8:16 PM");
  expect(snap.text, "the page does not show what only the failing order showed").not.toContain("October 24th 2026, 8:17 PM");
  // TODO: also assert what the user should see, e.g.
  // await expect(page.getByRole("listitem").first()).toContainText("...");
});
